reaction: It was satisfying to see the parts come together, though the model still leaves me curious about how supplies reach the cells.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding ribosomes was most worthwhile because it connected stored instructions to making proteins that serve as cell structures and machinery.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the final machinery felt somewhat routine because the named slot and the only compatible combination made the choice obvious.

surprise.text: I found it useful that mitochondria help replenish ATP but still need fuel, and that some ATP is made elsewhere in the cell.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly arbitrary; the named slots and explanations gave the fittings a purpose, although the compatible-partner menu guided the choices.

continue.text: I would continue into another chapter to see how the muscle fibers receive supplies and contribute to moving the arm. The connections so far were clear, even if some choices felt routine.
